run_DDP_Trainer_train_step: run a single training step on a batch of images with SMPL pose estimation and loss computation
run_DDP_Trainer_test: run evaluation on a test dataset and return reconstruction error in millimeters
create_DDP_Trainer: create a distributed DDP trainer with HMR model, SMPL body model, optimizer, and checkpoint support
run_DDP_Trainer_init_fn: initialize the HMR model, SMPL body model, optimizer, SMPLify module, and loss criteria for training
run_normalize_2dvector: normalize a 2D bone orientation vector and return the normalized vector with its norm
